subject: Mutual Action Plan: compliance checklist & gating timeline (SOC 2 / SIG / DPA)
messages:
From: Alice Cheng <alice.cheng@aurora-fin.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 2 Nov 2026 13:10:00 -0500
Subject: Mutual action plan & security gates – Aurora evaluation

Hi Monica / Karthik,

Thanks for the demo last week. Procurement asked that we put together a short MAP so legal and security can track the outstanding gates. High level asks from Aurora security and legal: SOC 2 Type II (scope for hosted inference endpoints), completed SIG/CAIQ responses, a clean DPA or DPA redlines, and explicit data retention & deletion commitments for PII.

Can you confirm what Redwood can provide and propose a target timeline so we can align with procurement (we're aiming to finish by 2026-11-20)? I attached a one-sheet MAP we started to populate.

Key questions up front:
- SOC 2: do you have a recent Type II report covering production inference endpoints (hosted API)? If yes, which period?
- SIG/CAIQ: will you share a completed CAIQ or summary of open controls?
- DPA: we prefer to send redlines; any standard exceptions Redwood requires (data residency, subcontractors)?
- Data retention: what's default retention for request logs, request/response payloads, and KV/cache remnants? Is customer-configurable?

Would appreciate a short list of owners on your side (AE / Security / Legal) and a proposed timeline.

Attachments: Aurora_MAP_v1.xlsx

Thanks,
Alice Cheng
Head of Cloud Risk | Aurora Financial
alice.cheng@aurora-fin.com
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Alice Cheng <alice.cheng@aurora-fin.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 2 Nov 2026 15:04:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Mutual action plan & security gates – Aurora evaluation

Alice — thanks for the clear list. We're aligned to move quickly to meet your 11/20 procurement target. Below is our proposed MAP snapshot (owners + gating items). I'll schedule a SOC deep-dive once you confirm who from Aurora Security will attend.

Proposed MAP snapshot (short):
- AE owner: Monica Patel (me) — overall MAP coordination and contract lead
- Security lead (Redwood): Karthik Iyer — SIG/CAIQ triage, SOC Q&A
- Legal: Laura Bennett — DPA and contract redlines

Security/compliance gates (what Redwood will provide):
1) SOC 2 Type II report (most recent period): Redacted report for period ending 2025-09-30. We'll provide a secure download link and SOC attestation.
2) SIG/CAIQ: completed CAIQ export (annotated) + a short control summary indicating a few residual control exceptions related to customer-managed key rotation for Private on-prem deployments. We'll attach our CAIQ worksheet (Redwood_SIG_CAIX_template.xlsx) for your intake.
3) DPA: we accept standard commercial DPA terms; we review customer redlines case-by-case. Legal (Laura) will handle comments and propose changes.
4) Data retention & deletion: default telemetry/log retention = 365 days for metadata (token counts, latencies). Request/response payload retention is configurable per customer — default is 30 days for hosted API, optional 90/rolling 365 days for enterprise with dedicated capacity. We support on-demand purge for customer data upon termination and documented deletion procedures.
5) Key management: We support customer-managed keys via KMS for Dedicated/Private deployments; hosted API uses provider-managed encryption with options for Bring-Your-Own-Key in Dedicated.
6) Region & residency: We can pin your hosted traffic to us-east-1 and log storage in US-only regions.
7) Audit logs & forensics: delivery of request/response metadata and IAM audit trails for 365 days by default; longer retention options available as add-on.

Proposed schedule to hit 11/20 close (high level):
- 11/02: MAP kickoff (this thread) — Aurora provides initial DPA redlines and security contact
- 11/03–11/05: Redwood provides SOC download & completed CAIQ worksheet; Legal triage DPA redlines
- 11/06–11/10: Contract negotiations / final DPA round; Security deep-dive call (if needed)
- 11/11–11/16: Final internal approvals (Aurora procurement + Redwood legal)
- 11/17–11/20: Signature & PO / start provisioning (Dedicated pool if required)

Attachments we'll provide: Redwood_SIG_CAIX_template.xlsx (CAIQ export), SOC2_redacted_20250930.pdf (secure link to be sent), MAP_timeline_v1.xlsx if helpful. Please attach your DPA redlines to this thread.

If Aurora legal needs a short DPA summary (bullet points of exceptions we typically accept), Laura can post that here by EOD.

Best,
Monica Patel
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.ai
(attachment: Redwood_SIG_CAIX_template.xlsx)
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: Alice Cheng <alice.cheng@aurora-fin.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 3 Nov 2026 09:42:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Mutual action plan & security gates – Aurora evaluation

Quick note from Security: good to call out Private/on-prem scope separately in the MAP. For Aurora's PII workloads, if you plan to evaluate Private package, there are an extra set of controls we validate (HSM integration, air-gapped deployment checklist). For Hosted/Dedicated (our typical flow):
- SOC2 covers hosted inference control environment (we'll supply redacted report).
- SIG/CAIQ: we'll mark any controls that are "partial" because they depend on customer configuration (e.g., key rotation for BYOK).
- DPA: typical negotiation items we see: subprocessor list (we'll provide), breach notification SLAs, and deletion verification.

Operational note: we can provision a Dedicated pool for PII-in-scope traffic within ~10 business days of signature if Aurora wants that for logical isolation. If procurement needs faster start, we can enable canary capacity for eval traffic within 48–72 hours (limited throughput).

Karthik
Head of Security & Product Trust | Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.ai
From: Alice Cheng <alice.cheng@aurora-fin.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@aurora-fin.com, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 6 Nov 2026 11:34:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Mutual action plan & security gates – Aurora evaluation

Thanks — this is helpful and aligns well. Attached are our formal DPA redlines (Aurora_DPA_redlines.pdf) and the procurement PO template we need filled to accelerate signature. A few clarifying requests before we lock dates:

- SOC2: we need confirmation that the report explicitly calls out production inference endpoints and related support services (not just internal tooling). If you can point to the relevant control identifiers in the report, that would speed our review.
- Data retention: procurement & privacy want confirmation that request/response payloads can be limited to 90 days for our account (not just default 30). Can you confirm in writing that you can set 90-day retention for hosted with our account?
- Audit logs: legal asked if you can export session-level request metadata for 7 years as part of archival — I understand this is an add-on; please confirm options and cost/lead time.
- Subprocessors: please share your subprocessor roster (if not public), or a link to the current list.

Procurement deadline: we still aim to sign by 2026-11-20. If Redwood can confirm 90-day retention in writing and provide the SOC controls mapping by EOD Monday (11/09), we'll route the DPA to final legal approval.

Attachments: Aurora_DPA_redlines.pdf; Procurement_PO_template.docx

Best,
Alice Cheng
Head of Cloud Risk | Aurora Financial
